findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 7 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 30 questions numbered 1-30; by section: 7.1 2, 7.2 2, 7.3 2, 7.4 2, 7.5 4, 7.6 4, 7.7 2, 7.8 2, 7.9 2, 7.10 2, 7.11 4, 7.12 2.

15 pairs (theory 5 marks + numerical 3 marks) covering wave parameters and v = f lambda, superposition, interference of sound, formation of stationary waves, the stretched string (first, second and nth modes), organ pipes open at both ends and closed at one end, the microwave experiment, diffraction and the ripple tank, beats, intensity, both Doppler cases and the applications of the Doppler effect. Numericals use new values, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: Case 2 Doppler shift u_s/f with lambda_D = (v + u_s)/f; f3 = 3f1 of a closed pipe is the third harmonic; loud to faint in beats takes half the beat period.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
